readingRules.M3: ASYMMETRIC by pre-registration. Null or negative = STRONG evidence against improvement. Positive = WEAK, and BARRED from the headline and the verdict.
readingRules.M2_SC: The confounded S-vs-C contrast. Reported for completeness; cannot carry any claim.
readingRules.power: n=17 detects only a LARGE effect (sign test needs 13 of 17; 80% power only at a true win rate of 0.813). A non-significant result means no LARGE effect was detected, NOT that there is no effect.
